'''BKFC Knucklemania VI''' was a bare-knuckle fighting event that was held by Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship on February 7, 2026.<ref name="knucklkevi">{{Cite web |title=BKFC KNUCKLEMANIA VI |url=https://www.bkfc.com/events/knucklemania-vi|access-date=2026-01-13 |website=Bare Knuckle Fighting Championships}}</ref>

===Background===
A [[Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship#Heavyweight Championship|BKFC World Heavyweight Championship]] bout between champion [[Ben Rothwell]] and former [[UFC Heavyweight Championship|UFC Heavyweight Champion]] [[Andrei Arlovski]] took place at the event.<ref name="arlovskirothwell">{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/bkfc/462105/ben-rothwell-vs-andrei-arlovski-yoel-romero-returns-for-bkfc-knucklemania-vi|title=Ben Rothwell vs. Andrei Arlovski, Yoel Romero returns for BKFC KnuckleMania VI|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Damon Martin|date=2025-12-18|access-date=2026-01-13}}</ref> The two previously met twice in mixed martial arts: first in July 2008 at ''Affliction: Banned'', where Arlovski won by third‑round knockout, and again in July 2019 at [[UFC on ESPN: dos Anjos vs. Edwards]], where Arlovski earned a unanimous decision victory.<ref name="arlovskirothwell"/>

A heavyweight bout between current [[Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship#Light heavyweight Championship|BKFC Light Heavyweight World Champion]] (also former [[Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship#Cruiserweight Championship|Cruiserweight World Champion]]) [[Lorenzo Hunt]] and former [[UFC Middleweight Championship]] challenger [[Yoel Romero]] (also former [[Bellator Light Heavyweight World Championship]] challenger) was scheduled to serve as the co-main event.<ref name="arlovskirothwell"/> However, Romero became ill with the flu and was replaced by current [[Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship#Middleweight Championship|BKFC Middleweight Champion]] [[David Mundell (fighter)|David Mundell]] in a non-title 199 lb catchweight bout.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/bkfc/468352/yoel-romero-out-of-bkfc-knucklemania-vi-lorenzo-hunt-gets-new-opponent|title=Yoel Romero out of BKFC KnuckleMania VI, Lorenzo Hunt gets new opponent|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Damon Martin|date=2026-01-28|access-date=2026-01-28}}</ref>

[[Matthew Semelsberger]] was scheduled to fight Prince Nyseam but he was forced to pull out of the fight due to severe neck pain and was replaced by Brett Shoenfelt.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Semelsberger |first=Matthew |title=Unfortunately I had to make the decision to pull out of my BKFC debut.  |url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DT9Gh6QkUbH/ |access-date=2026-01-28 |website=www.instagram.com}}</ref>

===Bonus awards===
The following fighters were awarded bonuses:<ref name="bkfc6results"/>

* '''Fight of the Night:''' Patrick Brady vs. Bear Hill
* '''Knockouts of the Night:''' Lorenzo Hunt and Cody Russell

The series aims to blend combat sports with heavy music in a single live event format.<ref name="bkfcblood"/>

Taylor Starling was scheduled to face Marisol Ruelas in a women's flyweight bout, but Ruelas was replaced by Sydney Smith for unknown reasons.
